The climate in Nessebar

Nessebar is about 17 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 28°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 1°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 70 mm). The highest temperature in Nessebar in 2015–2024 was 35°C (6 August 2017) and the lowest −12°C (9 January 2017).

Nessebar is on a rocky peninsula in Burgas Bay, next to Sunny Beach, and its climate is strongly shaped by the sea. Summers are sunny and warm, and the breeze makes the heat more bearable than inland. The beach season usually runs from June to mid-September, and winters are mild, if windy.

Best time to visit Nessebar

The most pleasant weather in Nessebar is usually in June and September: average highs are between 24°C and 25°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month.
